tokens.name: snow
tokens.usage: Page and packaging ground. A cool snowfield white, never cream.

tokens.name: snow-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, nutrition panels, anything sitting on snow.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, contour lines on snow, input borders.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, on snow and snow-raised.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions and data, on snow and snow-raised.

tokens.name: spruce
tokens.usage: The brand colour: wrapper field, primary buttons, the wordmark. As text, on snow.

tokens.name: on-spruce
tokens.usage: Text and marks on a spruce fill.

tokens.name: larch
tokens.usage: Autumn larch gold: the one warm accent. The sun on the pack, price and protein callouts, sale tags. Fill only, never text on snow.

tokens.name: on-larch
tokens.usage: Text on a larch fill, in both themes.

tokens.name: glacier
tokens.usage: Sky and meltwater: background bands, the far ridge on the pack, quiet tints. Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: rock
tokens.usage: Granite: the near mountain on the pack, dark photo overlays, footer bands. Text on it is snow (light theme).

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Archivo set wide: font-stretch 125%. Like the lettering on technical mountain gear.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero lines, the flavour name on the pack, one per layout.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Product names in lists, card titles.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Made in small batches from dates, nuts and grass-fed whey.

tokens.name: space-s
tokens.usage: Inside tags and buttons, icon gaps.

tokens.name: space-l
tokens.usage: Between blocks inside a section, contour line pitch.

tokens.name: space-xl
tokens.usage: Between sections, outer margins on the pack and on posts.

radius.note: Cut stone: square corners. Pills only for small tags.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Photos, colour bands, cards, the pack itself.
